portfolio_thesis: Combines concentrated exposure to the AI infrastructure buildout (NVDA, AVGO) with a diversified mega-cap software anchor (MSFT), balanced by non-correlated defensive holdings (LLY, COST) and a cash buffer to dampen volatility over the three-month window.
expected_three_month_driver: Continued AI datacenter capital expenditure and earnings momentum from hyperscalers and semiconductor suppliers.
biggest_portfolio_risk: A sharp pullback in AI-related valuations or a slowdown in datacenter capex guidance could disproportionately hit the tech-heavy portion of the portfolio.
